name: Propertyware
description: Propertyware is single-family property-management software for portfolios, properties, residents, owners, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, reporting, custom workflows and third-party data exchange.
agentUseSummary: Propertyware is visible as a provider-access preview. Relay will not collect credentials or expose agent actions until a customer enables the paid Enterprise/API service and Propertyware supplies the exact production authentication, endpoint, permission, limit and tenant-authorization contract.

capabilities.label: Access approved property-management data
capabilities.description: After Propertyware enables and documents the customer's API service, expose only typed, bounded capabilities from the exact production contract and authorized portfolio.

blocked.label: Connect before Propertyware API enablement
blocked.description: Relay has no customer-enabled Enterprise/API service or provider-issued production contract to connect.

blocked.label: Collect undocumented Propertyware credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not request customer passwords, session material, API credentials or other secrets without Propertyware's supported integration instructions.

blocked.label: Access sensitive property data before review
blocked.description: Resident, applicant, owner, vendor, employee, address, lease, maintenance, screening, bank, accounting, payment and communication data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change Propertyware before contract review
blocked.description: Records, workflows, communications, accounting entries, payments, files and every other mutation remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Propertyware actions before contract review
blocked.description: No raw or typed API action is callable until Propertyware supplies and authorizes the production authentication, endpoint and permission contract.

approvalProfiles.label: Propertyware API enablement and contract review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable until a customer purchases and enables Enterprise/API access and Propertyware supplies a supported production integration contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable before Propertyware API enablement and production contract review.
No Hermes tools are callable before Propertyware API enablement and production contract review.

providerSetup.blocker: Propertyware publicly advertises two-way API data exchange, but its public pages do not publish an implementable production authentication, endpoint, schema, permission, rate-limit or tenant-authorization contract. Current pricing identifies Enterprise/API as a paid per-unit add-on and directs customers to contact Propertyware.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate provider-console task, have an authorized customer purchase and enable Enterprise/API access and obtain Propertyware's current production documentation and credentials. Confirm tenant and portfolio binding, credential lifecycle, permissions, limits, webhooks, permitted fields, customer authorization and third-party distribution terms, then implement and validate only typed, bounded and redacted tools.

evidence.supports: Propertyware officially describes an Open API with two-way data exchange for customer-selected third-party systems, dashboards, reporting, accounting, ticketing and CRM use cases, but the public page provides no authentication or endpoint reference.

Propertyware's current pricing states that Enterprise/API is an additional per-unit paid service and directs customers to contact Propertyware, establishing provider-enabled account access rather than an immediately self-service public contract.
Propertyware's terms bind service access to subscribed editions and order forms, restrict unauthorized access and third-party exploitation, and require users to protect account credentials.

Propertyware's RealPage privacy policy describes broad personal data involving residents, prospects and employee end users, supporting critical classification and field-level review before API access.
